synthesis.trait: Hardens up and claims responsibility/ownership under confrontation, projecting toughness rather than backing down
Cocky, showoff bravado when succeeding -- taunting, chest-puffing, declaring himself untouchable

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Cocky, showoff bravado when succeeding -- taunting, chest-puffing, declaring himself untouchable
turning_points.what_changes: In scene19_beat1 his bravado is untested -- he taunts after a real success (hitting the ball out). Here he faces genuine failure (struck out three times) for the first time, and his tough facade doesn't hold: he stares down the pitcher, throws his bat, and storms off frustrated. This exposes a previously unknown limit -- his confidence is contingent on winning and cracks under actual failure.
